guides.focus: Landmarks, single <h1>, sequential headings, aria-hidden decorative SVGs, aria-label on icon buttons
Apply text-wrap: balance specifically to headings (h1, h2, h3) and text-wrap: pretty on descriptions without global * selectors
<nav aria-label='Breadcrumbs'><ol> with aria-current='page', decorative CSS/aria-hidden separators, non-truncated current page label
overflow-wrap: break-word on body (with whitespace-nowrap on compact UI controls), responsive media bounds, min-block-size >= 44px touch targets, avoid truncating headings
color-scheme: light | dark parity on root and isolated preview surfaces
Intrinsic sizing with min-w-0 inside flex/grid tracks to prevent horizontal overflow
Consistent container widths (max-w-7xl) and 2x2 mobile / 4-column desktop metric grids
Fluid clamp() scale respecting --font-size-multiplier and tabular numbers on KPIs
